chunks.title: faq
chunks.heading: How do I book an appointment?
chunks.text:
How do I book an appointment?

Call (555) 014-7721 or use our online form at brightsmile-demo.example/book (demo link only).

chunks.title: faq
chunks.heading: Do you see children?
chunks.text:
Do you see children?

Yes. We welcome patients age 3 and older. Younger children may be referred to a pediatric specialist.

chunks.title: faq
chunks.heading: Is whitening safe for sensitive teeth?
chunks.text:
Is whitening safe for sensitive teeth?

We assess sensitivity during a consult. Mild sensitivity is common for 24–48 hours after in-office whitening.

chunks.title: faq
chunks.heading: Do you offer dental implants?
chunks.text:
Do you offer dental implants?

No. Implant placement is referred to Maple Grove Oral Surgery (partner).

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.text: # Insurance & Billing FAQ (Sample Data)

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.heading: Do you accept insurance?
chunks.text:
## Do you accept insurance?

We are **in-network** with these fictional plans for demo purposes:

- Maple Health PPO
- River Valley Dental HMO
- Summit Care Open Access

Bring your member ID to your visit. We file claims on your behalf.

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.heading: Payment without insurance
chunks.text:
## Payment without insurance

We accept cash, credit cards, and CarePlan financing (subject to approval). Payment is due at time of service unless a prior arrangement is documented.

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.heading: Cancellation policy
chunks.text:
## Cancellation policy

Please cancel or reschedule at least **24 hours** in advance. Late cancellations may incur a **$50** fee.

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.heading: Records requests
chunks.text:
## Records requests

Email **records@brightsmile-demo.example** with your name and date of birth. Allow 3 business days for copies.

chunks.title: new-patient-guide
chunks.text: New Patient Guide (Sample Data)  Bring insurance card and arrive 15 minutes early.  First visit includes exam, cleaning, and X-rays when needed.

chunks.title: services
chunks.text:
# Bright Smile Dental — Services (Sample Data)

Bright Smile Dental Clinic offers general and cosmetic dentistry for families in the fictional town of Maple Grove.

chunks.title: services
chunks.heading: Preventive care
chunks.text:
## Preventive care

- **New patient exam and cleaning** — $129 (sample price). Includes X-rays for most adults.
- **Routine cleaning (every 6 months)** — $89 for established patients.
- **Fluoride treatment (children)** — $35.

chunks.title: services
chunks.heading: Restorative
chunks.text:
## Restorative

- **Composite filling (1 surface)** — from $165.
- **Crown (porcelain)** — from $980; we provide a written estimate after exam.

chunks.title: services
chunks.heading: Cosmetic
chunks.text:
## Cosmetic

- **Professional whitening (in-office)** — $450 per session.
- **Take-home whitening kit** — $199.

chunks.title: services
chunks.heading: Emergency
chunks.text:
## Emergency

We reserve same-day slots for **tooth pain, swelling, or broken teeth**. Call **(555) 014-7721** before 2:00 PM Mon–Fri for same-day availability.

chunks.title: services
chunks.heading: What we do not offer
chunks.text:
## What we do not offer

We do **not** provide orthodontic braces, oral surgery, or sleep-apnea appliances. We refer those cases to partner specialists.

chunks.title: welcome
chunks.text:
Bright Smile Dental Clinic — Welcome (Sample Data)

Our mission is comfortable, transparent dental care for Maple Grove families.
